title: YY1-NSUN7-mC-HSPA1B axis drives polycystic ovary syndrome pathogenesis via epigenetic stabilization of HSPA1B mRNA.
snippet: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is the most common endocrine disorder in reproductive-age women. Heat shock 70 kDa protein 1B (HSPA1B) is critical for stress response and inflammation, but its role in PCOS remains unknown.
